why_relevant: Practitioner commentary that flags each levy amendment quickly and explains scope changes (e.g. securities 2022, e-money 2025) in plain language — a fast early-warning layer over the gazette.

source_name: BKIK - Budapesti Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara (Budapest Chamber of Commerce and Industry)
why_relevant: Territorial chamber that republishes and localises MKIK rapid surveys, including one on the forint-euro exchange rate showing notably strong negative effects among financial and insurance services firms - i.e. sector-broken-out survey data usable for A4 context.

source_name: Budapesti Gazdaságtudományi Egyetem (BGE) – research news & Szemelvények series
why_relevant: BGE (formerly Budapest Business School, home of Budapest LAB) publishes applied research on financial literacy, SME finance and payment behaviour; a secondary academic producer beyond Corvinus with a practitioner orientation.

source_name: Dunai Gépgyártó / DG Zrt. (dgezrt.hu) – pénz- és értékszállítás service line
why_relevant: Additional HU operator offering money and valuables transport; useful for completing the long tail of the CIT actor map beyond the top three firms.

Fourth Big-4 firm in scope for this cell; EY Hungary issues local commentary and occasionally Hungary cuts of global consumer-banking/fintech adoption surveys. Included for completeness — no Hungary-specific payments study was surfaced in this pass.

Major HU CIT/cash-processing operator (G4S Készpénzlogisztikai Kft.), historically replenishing ATMs for OTP and foreign-owned banks and processing retail cash. Service pages reveal capability set, coverage and MNB-accredited equipment claims.
Meta-aggregator that surfaces postings from smaller HU boards and corporate career sites; useful as a recall net for niche acquiring/ATM/terminal roles missed by the big two.

Knowledge-base arm of a HU financial comparison brand; maintains evergreen explainers on cash-withdrawal rules and limits (e.g. the 2026 HUF 300,000 free monthly limit) that are updated as regulation changes — a cheap way to timestamp HU retail payment rule changes.

source_name: Neumann János Egyetem (NJE) – doctoral theses & GSZDI repository
why_relevant: NJE's economics doctoral school produces dissertations with original Hungarian consumer surveys on trust in financial services and AI-era banking; theses often contain fieldwork data unavailable elsewhere.

entity_name: OPTEN céginfó company profiles for HU banks
source_name: OPTEN céginfó company profiles for HU banks
why_relevant: Commercial company-intelligence vendor with structured financial history per bank entity (K&H, Raiffeisen, UniCredit observed). Useful for normalising entity identifiers and for time-series financials when statutory PDFs are inconsistent.

source_name: Payment Institutions Register EU (paymentinstitutionsregister.eu) — third-party mirror
why_relevant: Commercial/community re-presentation of the EBA PIR with easier browsing and filtering; useful for quick HU PSP lookups but must never be treated as authoritative over EUCLID.

entity_name: Pest Vármegyei és Érdi Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara
source_name: Pest Vármegyei és Érdi Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara - Felmérések, kutatások
why_relevant: Example of the county-chamber layer (there are ~19 territorial chambers, e.g. Zala: zvkik.hu) each hosting survey and research pages; regional granularity for SME payment behaviour and business conditions that the national chamber aggregates away.

source_name: Pénzügyi Navigátor Tanácsadó Irodahálózat (MNB consumer advisory network)
why_relevant: MNB-affiliated advisory network whose complaint intake and thematic guidance surface recurring card, ATM and account-fee problems ahead of formal statistics.
One of the oldest HU CIT operators (claims 1989 start); adds to the actor map of the domestic cash-transport market and its fragmentation.
